chunk_findings.detail: The change only sets `home_style="resolvable"` on the `log` profile. The bug report also says `ddflow show` of a task body rewrote the same home-directory path into `[REDACTED:path]`; the committed-view profile remains the default `home_style="marker"`. A task body containing `[REDACTED:path]` shown by `ddflow show` will therefore still be rendered as `[REDACTED:path]`, not `$HOME/sw-remote-bundle/patch`, so the operator still cannot recover the work from the task body.
chunk_findings.title: profiles.py:Profile("view", "", "", "")

chunk_findings.detail: The added regression tests only exercise the `lease.released` note path via `R.redact_event_data`. The same bug was also observed in `ddflow show` task bodies, but no added test calls the task-body redaction/render path. Given a task body containing `[REDACTED:path]`, the suite would still pass if `ddflow show` continued to emit `[REDACTED:path]` there, so the second half of B-redaction-hides-parked-work-path is not guarded by this regression test.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_log_redaction_all_kinds.py:test_a_parked_work_path_stays_resolvable_in_a_note

chunk_findings.detail: The resolvable fill only rewrites a match of the configured absolute home prefix. A parked-work note that uses the same directory in tilde form never reaches that fill: `p.sub(_TILDE_PATH, "path")` still applies the opaque marker. Given `home="[REDACTED:path]"` and a note `work kept in [REDACTED:path]` (or `work kept in ~zedd/patches/x`), the result is still `work kept in [REDACTED:path]`, so the recovery pointer the bug exists to preserve is gone.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/core/redact/engine.py:_home_fill

chunk_findings.detail: `home_style="resolvable"` is applied to the committed log profile, and `_home_fill` discards the username. Given a recorded note `work kept in [REDACTED:path]`, the log stores `work kept in $HOME/patches/x`. Read on any other account or machine, `$HOME` expands to that reader's home, not `[REDACTED:path]`, and the original prefix cannot be reconstructed. The pointer the bug asked for does not resolve to the parked work except for the original user in the original home.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/core/redact/profiles.py:Profile log home_style

chunk_findings.detail: That test only asserts `[REDACTED:path]` becomes `[REDACTED:path]`, which the pre-existing generic home pattern already did. It passes on the unfixed code and does not lock the new `$HOME` behavior, and nothing in the change covers a task-body redaction (`ddflow show`), the other symptom named in B-redaction-hides-parked-work-path.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_log_redaction_all_kinds.py:test_another_users_home_path_is_not_misread_as_resolvable
